formats.name: Standard
formats.description: Rotating constructed format using the most recent sets.

archetypes.name: Domain Ramp
archetypes.description: Five-color Domain shells that accelerate into huge threats and value engines. Relies on basic land diversity for Domain payoffs while ramping into haymakers.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: Cut soft interaction vs. aggro; bring in more sweepers and grave hate. Keep Binding flexible against midrange.

archetypes.name: Azorius Control
archetypes.description: Classic draw-go control with counterspells, sweepers, and a late-game planeswalker or token win condition. Punishes greedy midrange piles.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: Heavy on Rest in Peace / Negate for combo and graveyard decks; add more early removal vs. red aggro.

archetypes.name: Boros Aggro
archetypes.description: Low-curve aggressive deck looking to flood the board early and finish with burn or anthem effects. Favors initiative and tempo.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: Bring in protection and reach vs. control; add artifact/enchantment hate for Forge mirrors and lockdown decks.

archetypes.name: Dimir Midrange
archetypes.description: Interaction-heavy midrange with efficient threats and card advantage. Wins through attrition and well-timed fliers or discard.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: Extra discard and Duress vs. control; more cheap removal vs. aggro; grave hate when Domain is popular.

archetypes.name: Golgari Midrange
archetypes.description: Value midrange leveraging life gain, removal, and resilient threats. Comfortable in longer games against fair decks.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: Main plan is flexible hate pieces; lean into Frillback and enchantment removal when artifact/enchantment decks spike.

archetypes.name: Izzet Prowess
archetypes.description: Spell-slinging aggro that turns cheap cantrips and burn into oversized prowess threats. Explosive but fragile to sweepers.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: Counters and protection for control matchups; more burn density vs. midrange; avoid flooding the board into Temporary Lockdown.

formats.name: Modern
formats.description: Non-rotating constructed format with a deep card pool and diverse strategies.

archetypes.name: Rakdos Scam
archetypes.description: Grief + Undying / Evoke packages that cheat massive threats into play early while disrupting the opponent's hand.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: Extra discard and Leyline of the Void for graveyard decks; more interaction vs. combo; trim Scam density in mirror.

archetypes.name: Izzet Wizard Control
archetypes.description: Snapcaster Mage value control with Counterspell, Flame of Anor, and flexible interactive packages. Wins long games with card advantage.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: Stack hate for combo; more burn/removal vs. creature decks; Surgical Extraction when grave strategies are high.

archetypes.name: Affinity / Robots
archetypes.description: Artifact-centric aggro using cheap constructs, Urza's Saga, and free spells to overwhelm before interaction comes online.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: Wear // Tear and Nature's Claim from opponents hurt; side in counters and resilience; respect Stony Silence slots.

archetypes.name: Amulet Titan
archetypes.description: Combo-ramp deck using Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan to assemble lethal land loops, often as early as turn three.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: Dismember / Endurance packages for creature mirrors; bounce and interaction vs. hate bears; keep Pact density high.

archetypes.name: Yawgmoth
archetypes.description: Creature combo midrange that uses Yawgmoth, Thran Physician with undying creatures to draw cards and drain the opponent.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: Extra hate bears and Force of Vigor for artifact/enchantment strategies; trim combo pieces vs. heavy interaction.

archetypes.name: Hammer Time
archetypes.description: Equipment aggro that equips Colossus Hammer to a protected creature for sudden lethal damage, backed by cheap interaction.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: More protection and discard hate; respect Leyline of Sanctity and Stony Silence — have alternate plans ready.

archetypes.name: Living End
archetypes.description: Cascade combo that mills a pile of creatures then resolves Living End for a one-sided board wipe into a massive swing.
archetypes.sideboardNotes: Force of Vigor and Endurance fights; bring more interaction vs. hate; keep cascade density for consistency.
